title: The new and changed verification requirements, with their reasons (readiness)

assertions.name: readiness reports the recommissioning against baseline v1 and the substitution (asset, from, to)
it names the tests that must be re-run on the new camera, each with its reasons and its responsible role
every test whose plan row names the camera is required again, and the asset-identity check is required after the substitution
tests that do not depend on the camera are not reopened
re-acceptance is blocked with the reasons: the design change needs an approved revision, the reopened tests must be re-run, and the approved drawings no longer match
the drawing check opens design deficiencies for the approved equipment schedule and placement plan that no longer match
the outstanding actions name who must do what: approve revision 3 (not its author) and re-run per responsible role
completion counts only the results that still count: the reopened tests are not verified any more
an attempt to re-accept now is refused (422) with the same reasons
the re-acceptance refusal carries the accurate count: the superseded PASS_VERIFIED results count 0
readiness names the change with its units (SUBSTITUTED, original → new unit) and each position with its unit and identity state

the re-acceptance blockers come in the documented order — design binding (approve revision 3: the re-acceptance binds it), open issues, the reopened tests with the count — in the engine’s words, the same list in readiness and in the refusal

blockers: the design changed while the room is recommissioned (PA-0061 generic → SYN-PTZ-12X (synthetic PTZ camera)) and the approved revision 2 no longer describes it: revision 3 needs approval (room.design.approve, not its author) — the re-acceptance binds the approved revision
2 open issue(s): every deficiency is closed with its retest before acceptance

12 test(s) were last recorded before the substitution and must be re-run on the changed design and verified independently: identity_asset, display_controls, video_signal, camera_preset, video_camera_exposure, video_content_share, video_display_calibration, video_edid_handshake, video_switching, camera_fov, video_av_sync, video_camera_tracking — acceptance counts 63 of 75 applicable tests as passed and independently verified; the 12 earlier result(s) no longer count
next.separationOfDuties: not a recorder or verifier of the results

completion.basis: independently verified applicable tests over applicable tests; design approval never counts as commissioning progress; a result recorded before a recommissioning substitution of a device it covers does not count (revalidation)
